[29/09/2026, 22:10] Moses: Hello, I'm in Atlanta. My nephew in Kisii wants to start photography. Is the Canon EOS 250D still available?
[29/09/2026, 22:16] Esther: Hi Moses. Yes, with the 18-55mm kit lens and two batteries. I'd take $400
[29/09/2026, 22:18] Moses: $400 is ok
[29/09/2026, 22:20] Moses: Can you send it with G4S to Kisii?
[29/09/2026, 22:24] Esther: Yes. I'll hand it to G4S on 2nd October
[29/09/2026, 22:25] Moses: Good. Is the shutter count low?
[29/09/2026, 22:27] Esther: About 4,000 shots only
[29/09/2026, 22:28] Moses: Perfect, deal
notes: Diaspora buyer in USD with an absolute ship date (2 Oct) to G4S.
